description.en: Google Cloud Vertex AI with online model discovery and automatic project/global routing.
description.zh: Google Cloud Vertex AI，支持在线模型目录、自动识别项目和全球端点。

description.en: Enter an API key and upload Google Cloud credential JSON. The project is read automatically and model requests use the global endpoint by default.
description.zh: 填写 API Key 并上传 Google Cloud 凭证 JSON，自动识别项目，默认使用全球端点调用模型。

help_text.en: Upload a service account or ADC JSON file for online model discovery. Its project_id or quota_project_id is also used for model requests; the API key authenticates inference.
help_text.zh: 上传服务账号或 ADC JSON，用于在线刷新模型列表并识别项目；模型调用使用上方 API Key。

help_text.en: Global is recommended. Regional availability depends on the model and project; selecting a region keeps requests in that endpoint. A custom Base URL takes precedence.
help_text.zh: 推荐使用全球端点。各地区支持的模型及项目权限不同；选择地区后仅向该端点发送请求。已自定义的 Base URL 优先。

help_text.en: Only needed if the API key belongs to another project, or the ADC JSON has no project. An explicit project/location Base URL takes precedence.
help_text.zh: 仅当 API Key 属于其他项目，或 ADC 文件未包含项目时填写。无需手工拼接 Base URL。
